conceptNote: マットな黒と朱色の斜めの面、力強い白い文字を使う放送ポスター。下段の白い全画面マークの内側で、再生とチャットを一緒に見せる。
prompt:
Edge-to-edge landscape 11:7 composition (target 1760x1120).
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate ONE sophisticated abstract Chrome Web Store listing tile for the YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen extension. A premium red-and-black broadcast editorial campaign with exceptionally confident oversized typography. Do not create a contact sheet.
Design: near-black matte ground; one large flat vermilion-red geometric field with razor-clean edges; warm-white typography. Rich, restrained offset-print finish and barely perceptible grain. The result should look carefully typeset by an accomplished graphic design studio, not like a rendered app mockup.
Exact visible words, each phrase once only: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Put YouTube as a clean restrained eyebrow, Fullscreen and Live Chat as huge compact bold Swiss grotesk headline lines. Fullscreen is one word. No other copy, not even labels, numbers or tiny text. Words must be readable at 220x140.
Graphic meaning: show ONE front-facing horizontal 16:9 video frame, a simple play triangle at the left inside, and a strong off-white chat rectangle with a tiny speech tail and three simple red horizontal lines FULLY INSIDE the right side of that same video frame. Four clean fullscreen corner marks outside the frame. The video/frame and inset chat must read as one coherent symbol, never a separate external sidebar or separate apps. No made-up UI text.
Composition: strong editorial hierarchy, huge headline in the upper/left area and substantial geometric video/chat symbol in the lower/right. Compact 11:7 landscape poster, not a long panoramic banner. Keep all text within7% safe margins and every graphic complete within the canvas. The red field may create an intentional graphic background plane, but must not obstruct any letter or split the meaning of the symbol. Avoid visual clutter.
Palette only near-black, vermilion-red and warm-white. Flat graphic forms with exceptionally subtle tactile print texture; no cast shadows. No humans, faces, gaming, photos, devices, browser chrome, dashboards, fake messages or usernames, gradients, neon, glow, glassmorphism, floating3Dblobs, heavy depth, fake metallic shine or watermark.
